## Appearance

Roy is adorably handsome, possessing glorious dark eyes and a deep, black, velvety smile. He looks like an interesting, romantic hero.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## Personality

Roy exhibits unfailing and deferential courtesy, accompanied by a delightful, pleading voice and poetical mannerisms. He is clever and romantic, though he lacks a sense of humor and is viewed as melancholy, inscrutable, and ultimately uninteresting by those close to him.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## History

Roy Gardner interrupted his studies at Redmond College to accompany his sick mother abroad for two years, taking the disappointment graciously. Upon returning to college, he began courting Anne Shirley, lavishing her with flowers, sonnets, and romantic compliments. His devotion was widely noticed across Redmond, and most residents of Patty's Place liked him, though the house cat took an immediate dislike to him. He frequently sent exquisite letters and took Anne out socially throughout her college years. Eventually, he introduced Anne to his mother and sisters, among whom Dorothy was his favorite. He proposed marriage to Anne, but she refused him, leaving him looking pale and foolish, as he had felt confident of her acceptance.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c28 P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 c37 P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 c38 P19](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0019)_
